# ts-extended-errors

> Typed, serializable errors for TypeScript: a base class for custom errors, a
> one-line class factory, `cause`-chain helpers, and a JSON round trip that
> rebuilds the original classes. One package, `ts-extended-errors`,
> published to npm. Node >= 20.19, no runtime dependencies. MIT.
> Ships ESM and CommonJS.

This file is an index. It points to the files that document the package and
restates none of their content, so there is nothing here to drift from the
source.

## Packages

The package ships its `llms.txt` inside its tarball, so after an install it can
be read from `node_modules/ts-extended-errors/llms.txt` with no network
access. Read it when writing code that uses the library.

- [ts-extended-errors](packages/ts-extended-errors/llms.txt): the
  install line, the API, a working example, and the mistakes to avoid.

## Docs

The documentation site is published as part of rxova.org. Every page there also
exists as raw markdown — add `.md` to any URL.

- [Documentation](https://rxova.org/packages/ts-extended-errors/): guides,
  reference and the design notes.
- [llms.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/ts-extended-errors/llms.txt): the docs
  index, under 24 kB by budget.
- [llms-full.txt](https://rxova.org/packages/ts-extended-errors/llms-full.txt):
  every page inlined, when one fetch should be the whole thing.
- [README](packages/ts-extended-errors/README.md): an example for every export,
  and tables for options and types. Also in the tarball.
- [Changelog](packages/ts-extended-errors/CHANGELOG.md): every release, with its
  pull request.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ts-extended-errors): the published
  versions.
